scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:netlify: cd client && npm ci && npx react-scripts build
scripts.install-all: npm run install-client && npm run install-server && npm run install-functions
scripts.deploy: git add -A && git commit -m "Auto deploy $(date)" && git push
scripts.quick-deploy: echo 'Making quick change...' && echo // Updated at $(date) >> client/src/App.js && npm run deploy
